1722-2034-3583-3845.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-3845.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

2023-3499-4518-6006.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

222-308-4871-6495.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Saproling.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
222-308-4871-6495.description:
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing a nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
222-308-4871-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2292-2415-7173.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2292-2415-7173.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

5508-5641-6854.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Railway Brawler triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Railway Brawler triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

997-1379-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
997-1379-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Encroaching Mycosynth and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Woe Strider.

301-4535-7859.description:
Activate Goblin Chirurgeon by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Goblin Chirurgeon ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

549-2388-6587-7715.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
549-2388-6587-7715.description:
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

3617-4428-7722.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Thassa.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Walk from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

4499-6723-7175-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

4947-5078-5434-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1084-1242-7325.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's first ability by tapping it.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mighty Mutanimals triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cinderhaze Wretch.
Resolve the Cinderhaze Wretch ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

513-1636.notablePrerequisites:
You have a nonland creature card in hand.
You control another nontoken nonland reature.
Other creatures you control can tap to produce enough mana to cast both creatures mentioned above after being tapped twice.
513-1636.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding an amount of mana.
Cast the creature from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning another creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the creature spell. When it enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
513-1636.notes: Ideally, if the two creatures require different amounts of mana, you will want to start the combo with the lower cost creature in your hand. This should negate the need to start with mana. However, the opposite can be done if you provide mana (as needed) to cover the difference. An example of the prerequisite: If the creatures have total cost {3}{U}{U}, other creatures you control, after tapping two times each, must produce at least {3}{U}{U}. Therefore, if creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}{U}, they will create {4}{U}{U} after being tapped twice, and meet the prerequisite.

465-4681-5686.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

628-6797-7189.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dread Tiller.
When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

1545-2919-3490-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-2919-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

136-4067-6281-6893.notablePrerequisites: The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it.
136-4067-6281-6893.description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding at least twenty {U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Cadaver Imp.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Cadaver Imp that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Cadaver Imp token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cadaver Imp from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat.

883-2173-2438-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

2104-6333-6336.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
2104-6333-6336.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Haystack by paying {2} and tapping it, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

851-2457-4289-4359.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

101-5352.notablePrerequisites: There are four permanents on the battlefield that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
101-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {15}{G}{U}, creating five token copies of Vampire Charmseeker and of the four mana-producing permanents.
When the Vampire Charmseeker tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Doppelgang and up to four other creature, instant or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seventeen of the mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {15}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tokens and mana, you may instead target any other permanents using Doppelgang.

1558-3129-3775.notablePrerequisites:
You have the initiative.
You have completed a dungeon.
1558-3129-3775.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Safana triggers, creating six Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasure tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2499-2792-3859.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
2499-2792-3859.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Great Whale enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first Great Whale trigger, untapping the seven lands.
Activate the seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{B}.
Resolve the second Great Whale trigger, untapping the seven lands.
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying {U}{B}.
Cavern Harpy enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, returning Cavern Harpy and Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

654-774-5033.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}.
654-774-5033.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Storm Cauldron triggers twice, returning both lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting both lands from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

868-3044-4036-4285.description:
Cast Desperate Ritual for {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Seething Song for {2}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Cast Ill-Gotten Gains for {2}{B}{B} and hold priority.
Cast Increasing Vengeance for {R}{R}, copying Ill-Gotten Gains.
Resolve the copied Ill-Gotten Gains, discarding your hand and then returning Desperate Ritual, Seething Song, and Increasing Vengeance to your hand.
Cast Desperate Ritual for {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Seething Song for {2}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

142-662-1434.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli Rai has at least two loyalty counters on it.
142-662-1434.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Saheeli Rai to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Saheeli Rai's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, creating a token copy of itself that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
Repeat step 2.

570-2024-3295.notablePrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
570-2024-3295.description:
Activate Swirling Spriggan by paying {G/U}{G/U}, making a creature you control all colors until end of turn.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{W}{G}, giving Faeburrow Elder +3/+3 until end of turn and untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
